postal_system.current_directory_shape_rule: Four digits; the currently published directory uses first digits 1 through 8. Syntax alone is not a live assignment.
postal_system.coding_method_rule: The dated UPU sheet maps the first digit to region and remaining digits to post office; current Niger Poste rows map code, locality and region and must be pinned independently.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Only a current digest-pinned Niger Poste code-to-locality row with observed_at, valid-time and approved field rights can become official_postal_operator assignment evidence.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The current Niger Poste directory and dated UPU sheet publish no boundary coordinates. Default full-code geometry is none; locality, region, agency point, buffer, Voronoi surface, model output and AGID cover are never an official postcode polygon.
postal_system.address_rule: The four-digit postcode is placed before the locality. BP/P.O. Box identifier, physical street or quarter, administrative region and postcode are separate fields; the dated 2005 P.O.-Box-only statement must not override current Niger Poste services.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic address point, matching normalized components, an explicit address-to-building relation and independently licensed building geometry. Postcode, nearest feature, text match, containment and model score are insufficient.
postal_system.land_rule: IGN.N administrative, cadastral, topographic and land products remain product-specific controlled context. A parcel or map does not prove a postal assignment, civic address, building, owner, resident or occupant.
postal_system.privacy_rule: HAPDP Law 2022-59 and amendments require lawful purpose, proportionality, security and bounded retention. Person-linked precise addresses, recipients, box holders, residents, owners, occupants, instructions and query histories are not public artifacts.
postal_system.realtime_rule: Live observations become bounded normalized receipts with source URL, terms version, digest, observed_at, valid-time and parser version; there is no invisible unverified live fallback or training mirror.
postal_system.model_rule: Learned models may rank candidates, detect drift, compress search indexes or propose derived surfaces. They never confer official assignment, polygon, address, building or deliverability authority.
postal_system.compression_rule: A compact code-to-locality index, minimal perfect hash and PMTiles, FlatGeobuf or Parquet candidate layers are allowed only while exact code strings, validity, authority, lineage and correction paths remain recoverable.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only digest-pinned, rights-cleared, minimized, non-personal public artifacts. Restricted geographic or address evidence remains on controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index and crosswalk. An AGID cell or cell union is not a Niger Poste code or polygon, administrative boundary, parcel, civic address or building.

validation_rules.pass: Every assignment has a current Niger Poste row, approved rights, digest and observation time.
Every current code has four digits and a first digit between 1 and 8; shape never substitutes for a row.
No code is published with canonical Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry without issuer-authorized boundary evidence.
Postal, administrative, land, address, building and AGID authority are stored separately.
Explicit rights-cleared address-building relation and matching normalized components are present.
No personal, contact, land-holder, subscriber, recipient, occupant or query data is published and every field has approved rights.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, semantics, licences and blockers inventoried.
Contract, source profile and synthetic conformance fixtures reviewable.
Rights-cleared observations reproduce a digest-pinned experimental pack.
Independent holdout, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two consecutive refreshes pass and rollback is monitored.
